title: Circular No. 32 - Evacuation Scheme - British Women And Children

page_data.en:
（批：Sr. (C)
SMP REC
S.L.D. 3311
1.3.32.）

Headquarters,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
February 28, 1932.

CIRCULAR NO. 32.

Officers in charge of Stations.

Evacuation Scheme - British Women and Children

Lists of British Subjects arranged according to the Police
Districts in which they reside, will be forwarded to Stations
in the course of the next day or two. The officer in charge
of each District will cause his District to be divided and
allotted to particular members of the Force in such a way that,
if the necessity should arise, women and/or children can be
quickly warned to proceed to their appointed concentration
centres. A preliminary visit will be made by the men detailed
for this work to each address given for the purpose of ascer-
taining whether there are women and/or children to be evacuated.
In cases where women and/or children are not involved the names
will be deleted from the lists. Where it is found that a mis-
take has been made in the district lists the names etc. will be
forwarded direct to the Station concerned and a duplicate of
such transfers forwarded to Headquarters.

Where wrong addresses are given, or where residents have
left, or changed their residences, the names and such information
as is available will be forwarded to Headquarters. Forms for
use in this connection are distributed with the lists.

（签名）
Commissioner of Police.
page_data.zh:
（批注：Sr. (C)
上海公共租界警务处档案
S.L.D. 3311
1932年3月1日。）

上海公共租界工部局警务处总部，
1932年2月28日。

第32号通令。

致各巡捕房主管官。

撤离方案——英国妇女及儿童

按居住所在警区排列的英籍人士名单，将在未来一两天内发送至各巡捕房。各区主管官须将其辖区划分，并分配给警队特定成员，以便在必要时，能迅速通知妇女和/或儿童前往指定的集中中心。负责此项工作的人员将对所列地址进行初步走访，以核实是否有需要撤离的妇女和/或儿童。若不涉及妇女和/或儿童，其姓名将从名单中删除。若发现分区名单有误，相关姓名等信息将直接转送至有关巡捕房，并将此类转移记录的副本报送总部。

若地址错误，或居民已搬离、变更住所，应将姓名及现有信息报送总部。与此相关的表格随名单一并分发。

（签名）
警务处处长。
